name: Kuro Daiya
source:
Daiya is a strange young man who has just moved to Tomomi's hometown. Though it's still a bit cold for serious planting work, he hires Tomomi to landscape his new house nonetheless.

He is cheerful, earnest, spacey, and innocent. As such, his personality sticks out almost as much as his looks. What's his deal?

Flowers and his motorcycle are the great loves of his life.

(from [url=https://dialoguelostloop.tumblr.com/refinery]tumblr[/url])
